# Grand Sponsor: 2nd Cyber Intelligence Summit 2026

CENSUS is honored to participate as a **Grand Sponsor** of the **2nd Cyber Intelligence Summit 2026**, held under the theme **"Information as Defense: From Everyday Practice to Global Strategy"** on February 5 at the Athens Concert Hall.

![](/static/media/uploads/blog/cyber_intelligence_2026_census.jpg)

[**Book a meeting**](https://meet-the-census-experts.setmore.com/services/9842403b-35d1-4e49-825a-d00c0c88b4ea)

**Don't miss:** Nikos Tsagkarakis, CEO at CENSUS participation at the panel discussion, "Technology in Military Operations".
We would be delighted to welcome you for a conversation, whether to exchange perspectives, explore shared challenges, or identify meaningful opportunities for collaboration.

*The Summit is convened under the auspices of the **Ministry of National Defense (Greece)**, the **Ministry of Digital Governance (Greece)**, the **Ministry of Defense (Cyprus)**, and the **Deputy Ministry of Research, Innovation and Digital Policy (Cyprus)**.* <https://cyberintelligence.gr/>
